## Epic 1: Record and list submissions

The first epic stands the store up and puts one submission through it.

**FRs covered:** FR1, FR2

**NFRs covered:** NFR1

### Story 1.1: Record a submission

As an operator, I record a submission so that it is retained. (FR1, NFR1, AR1)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** an operator with a submission
**When** it is sent
**Then** it is recorded and retrievable.

### Story 1.2: List the recorded submissions

As an operator, I list what has been recorded. (FR2)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Given** recorded submissions
**When** the list is requested
**Then** it names every recorded submission.
